content.title: Oil prices rise, Dropbox & Six Flags earnings
content.description:
Here are some of the stories Wall Street is watching on Friday, Nov. 7. Oil (CL=F) prices are rising following a sell-off earlier in the week. Dropbox (DBX) shares are jumping after posting third quarter results that beat estimates on both the top and bottom lines. Six Flags (FUN) posted a revenue decline in the third quarter.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
